gui.panel.model.title: Model
gui.panel.compare.title: Compare
gui.model.empty: Add and select a camera first, then load a model to recognize things.
gui.model.ab: Keep the current model and add a second one for A/B comparison
gui.model.ab.tip: Run two models on the same camera. The second one is drawn with dashed boxes and other colors. At most two.
gui.model.err.card_hint: Check that it is a valid .card.json, or choose the model file itself.
gui.model.err.unexpected: Something unexpected happened while running the model: {error}
gui.model.err.unexpected_hint: Try another backend, or see Help > Diagnostics for details.
gui.model.kmodel_only_k210: .kmodel files can only run on a K210 board. Open and select a K210 camera first, then load this model.
gui.model.device_failed: The board could not load the model.
gui.model.ambiguous.title: Please confirm the output format
gui.model.ambiguous.text: The program is not sure about this model's output format. Possible choices are listed below, best first (hover for the reason). If the boxes look wrong, try another one.
gui.model.th.conf.help: Results scoring below this are hidden. Raise it for fewer false alarms, lower it to miss less.
gui.model.th.nms.help: When one object is boxed several times, boxes overlapping more than this keep only the best-scoring one.
gui.model.th.max_det.help: The most detections shown per frame.
gui.model.th.agnostic: Also merge boxes of different classes
gui.model.th.agnostic.help: When on, overlapping boxes of different classes keep only one (avoids one object labelled as two classes).
gui.model.th.neighbors.help: Higher is stricter with fewer false alarms but misses more; lower detects more easily.
gui.model.th.note.haar: Haar detection has no real probability, so the confidence threshold has no effect. Use Sensitivity (neighbors) instead.
gui.model.th.note.device: The model runs on the board, so only the confidence threshold can be changed here.
gui.model.th.note.classify: A classification model always gives its top scores and does not use these thresholds.
gui.model.input.note: With "processed", boxes may not line up with the original picture if the pipeline crops or resizes. "Original" is recommended.
gui.model.live.stats: Inference {fps} fps; per frame: preprocess {pre} ms, inference {infer} ms, postprocess {post} ms ({total} ms total); result is {age} frames old
gui.model.live.device_missing: The board has not sent a result yet. Check that the model is loaded on the board.
gui.model.save_card.need_project: The model's folder is not writable. Open a project first; the card will be saved in its models folder.
gui.rawout.title: Raw output viewer
gui.rawout.intro: These are the numbers the model outputs, before they are turned into boxes or classes. The shapes and value ranges tell you the output format, which helps when writing a model card.
gui.rawout.empty: No raw output yet. Check that frames are arriving and the model is loaded.
gui.rawout.shown: The table shows only the first {rows} rows and {cols} columns.
gui.rawout.unsupported: This model is not a neural network run on the computer (for example Haar or a board model), so there is no raw output to show.
gui.compare.help: See every camera and model side by side: how smooth the camera is, how sharp the picture is, how fast the model is, and how often it detects something.
gui.compare.reset_done: Stats were reset and are counted again from now.
gui.compare.export_failed: Could not save the comparison table: {error}
gui.compare.need_project: Open a project first; the table is saved in its logs folder.
gui.compare.no_rows: There are no cameras, so there is nothing to export.
gui.compare.fair: For a fair comparison: point all cameras at the same scene under the same light, and compare over the same period of time. After changing a model or camera, press "Reset all stats" before you start timing.
